rules: Amounts are per adult one-way in JPY, standard ordinary rides, without optional reserved-seat surcharges.
Each pair applies in reverse direction too, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Group same-operator continuous rides across physical line boundaries and transfers; station geometry is not fare evidence.
The available search evidence is current as of the requested checkedAt date; January 2027 travel requires a pretravel recheck.
Official Osaka Metro/Fukuoka subway tariff pages support fare bands; station-pair amounts are independently retrieved route results. Fare values are not geometric-distance estimates.
